nodes.label: menulis Skill (Pipeline Penulisan SEO)
nodes.rationale: External skill (C:\Users\boim\.agents\skills\menulis\SKILL.md) providing the SEO-writing pipeline — keyword analysis, outline, 1200+ word article, humanization — that all generated articles must follow.

nodes.label: Google AI Optimization Guide (2026)
nodes.rationale: Google states SEO remains relevant but only non-commodity, people-first, unique-POV content gets cited by AI Overviews; AEO/GEO tactics (llms.txt, chunking, AI-specific rewriting, inauthentic mentions) are unproven. This guide is the strategic basis for the entire content workflow.

nodes.label: Prinsip Non-Komoditas & People-First
nodes.rationale: Google AI Overviews/RAG only cites non-commodity content with a unique angle; commodity content (generic, reworded) is not cited. Hence write for humans not AI, avoid llms.txt/chunking/AI-specific rewriting, include specific data and first-hand experience.

nodes.label: CV Pireki Asia
nodes.rationale: The company writes as the actual manufacturer (not reseller or external reviewer) to establish authority and E-E-A-T; founded 2008, self-production since 2011, 1000+ projects installed.

nodes.label: SOREPA Pro (Sound Reduce Partition)
nodes.rationale: Flagship premium product; mechanical jack inside the partition for maximum sound dampening (up to 60 dB) and no bottom rail for a clean elegant look — design decisions that justify premium positioning for ballrooms and corporate meeting rooms.

nodes.label: Samowa Lipat (Standard Movable Wall)
nodes.rationale: Mid-range semi-damped folding wall, most popular; lacks the Sorepa mechanical jack so dampening is inferior — a deliberate cost/quality trade-off versus the premium Sorepa line.

nodes.label: Nice Partition
nodes.rationale: Most economical folding product; intentionally omits glasswool/rockwool and mechanical jack to hit the lowest price while keeping an elegant aesthetic.

nodes.label: Partisi Geser Pireki
nodes.rationale: Sliding partition as the middle path between open space and privacy; transforms rooms rapidly without sacrificing aesthetics, flexibility or sound control.

nodes.label: Sales Penjualan Partisi Geser Pireki
nodes.rationale: Single shared sales/consultation contact (0823-7673-7701 via phone/WhatsApp) embedded as the conversion CTA on every ruangan page.

nodes.label: Sorepa Stucking
nodes.rationale: Neatly stacked when not in use — solves space waste and stores the partition efficiently without leaving traces or sacrificing storage space.

nodes.label: Sorepa 1 Roda
nodes.rationale: Easy-to-mount wheels give maximum mobility for fast layout changes (exhibitions, parties).

nodes.label: Samowa Persection
nodes.rationale: High sound isolation creating quiet, comfortable rooms — ideal for meetings/seminars where privacy and focus are key; damps conversation between training classes.

nodes.label: Samowa Lipat
nodes.rationale: Easy folding action gives high space-use efficiency; affordable and very easy to operate for anyone (places of worship).

nodes.label: Sorepa
nodes.rationale: Highest sound-damping capability with tidy stucking storage — recommended for ballroom multi-event use.

nodes.label: Samowa
nodes.rationale: Flexible, economical inter-department divider; HPL/sheet finishes easy to clean (medical facilities); balanced sound damping and ease of use for classrooms.

nodes.label: Sorepa Pro
nodes.rationale: Precision mechanical system plus tight rubber seals for maximum soundproofing to support business confidentiality.

nodes.label: Nice Partition (Tipe)
nodes.rationale: Positioned as the most economical Pireki partition (Rp 1.550.000/m2) to capture budget-conscious buyers; keeps elegance via aluminium lis finish and simple rel-dan-roda sliding so low price does not read as low quality.

nodes.label: Sorepa Prima (Tipe)
nodes.rationale: Mid-tier of the Sorepa sound-damping line: 78 mm aluminium frame and 60 kg/m3 rockwool for strong acoustic isolation aimed at meeting/training rooms that want silence on an older profile.

nodes.label: Sorepa Pro (Tipe)
nodes.rationale: Flagship maximum-isolation tier: 105 mm aluminium frame + 80 kg/m3 rockwool + sheet foam for ballrooms, conference rooms and studios that demand the highest acoustic performance; priced at Rp 2.700.000/m2.

nodes.label: Sound Isolation Design (Rockwool + Rubber Seal)
nodes.rationale: Sorepa line differentiates tiers purely by acoustic density (rockwool 60/60/80 kg/m3 and frame width 70/78/105 mm) while reusing the same mechanic-device sliding and rubber-seal closure; denser rockwool + wider frame = higher price tier and stronger isolation.

nodes.label: Samowa Center-Hinge Folding System
nodes.rationale: Engsel tengah / kupu-kupu connects doors into one folding unit, chosen for structural strength and an artistic character that sliding partitions lack; the folding format also omits soundproofing hardware, keeping Samowa affordable.

nodes.label: PIREKI brand logo asset set (PNG/ICO/SVG variants)
nodes.rationale: Three formats of the same site logo exist side by side: SVG (preferred by BaseHead link[rel=icon] and Schema.astro structured-data logo), ICO (AboutAuthor author-avatar and BaseHead fallback), and PNG 512x512. PNG is the high-resolution raster source.
